title: Segfault/UB from expat when re-entering the XML Parser
live_proof: measured, not asserted: the trigger runs on the pinned 3.13.7 ASan build (PYTHONMALLOC=malloc, ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0) and reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free in a 524288-byte region. Running it is the liveness proof -- a sanitizer report here means the defect is present in this tree.
fidelity: the trigger is upstream's own reproducer from the issue, run through the real interpreter rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it.
allocator_layer: libc malloc (the object never reaches a pymalloc pool)
status: host oracle measured 2026-10-06 on the pinned ASan build; no arm has been run
